actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The card's main scene includes the Unitree G1 MJCF model
The card's main scene also includes the shared obstacle and ground scene scene.xml
The G1 model integrates with the Euler scheme at a 0.002 s timestep
The G1 model carries a site named 'lidar' on the torso at position 0 0 0.405
The body tree has a freejoint named floating_base_joint and 29 named hinge joints
The actuator section has 29 position actuators, one per leg, waist, arm and wrist joint
The position actuator default sets inheritrange to 1, so an actuator's ctrlrange is its joint range: the hip pitch -2.5307 to 2.8798, the hip roll -0.5236 to 2.9671 and the knee -0.087267 to 2.8798
The scene's home keyframe supplies a qpos and ctrl starting pose
The included scene.xml adds a ground plane and four wall boxes around the robot
The G1 example constructs MjLidarWrapper for that model with site_name 'lidar'
MjLidarWrapper takes the MuJoCo model and the name of the LiDAR site
MjLidarWrapper.trace_rays traces rays and returns a distance array with the same shape as the theta and phi ray angles

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge takes no seed input and a reset restores the model defaults, so a run repeats exactly on the same engine but no seed selects a different one

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it reads the model file for the actuator count, the control ranges and the qpos/qvel layout but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target, so trajectories, contacts and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
no mesh or texture of the asset directory is loaded and no contact, equality, tendon or sensor constraint is resolved by the stand-in

NOT COVERED: the LiDAR range image (one distance per ray, the same shape as the theta and phi arrays) and the point cloud that MjLidarWrapper.trace_rays produces; cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 carry the world state only, so the scan, the scan patterns, the cpu/taichi/jax/warp backends, the cutoff distance and the sensor pose are not exposed by this package
MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine, and no LiDAR scan was produced
no physical LiDAR or robot is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
